name: Post Up
idea: Get low near the basket, keep your defender on your back, and call for the ball.
why: Close to the basket is the easiest place to score. When your defender is stuck on your back, one big step gets you to the hoop.
tryit: Bend your knees, keep your elbows out, and hold one hand up as a target. When you catch it, peek over your shoulder before you turn.

frames.say: {5} is our big player. {1} has the ball on the wing.
*Post up:* {5} runs to the block, gets low and wide, and keeps {X5} on their back.
*Entry pass:* {1} throws a bounce pass to {5}, on the side away from {X5}.
*Drop step:* {5} turns toward the baseline with one big step and one dribble. {X5} is on the wrong side.
Layup! Get low, show your hands, and finish strong.
